rules.window: whole local hours, 3 to 6, starting from 05:00 to 20:00 and ending by 24:00, passing the clauses. A candidate's is the one of most leverage: the largest (naive - hindsight) / hindsight, naive the empty plan run by core.sim.execute and hindsight the MIP optimum (refs.mip, proven within 60 s), ties to the earlier start, then the shorter. A control's is its disruption window: the shortest holding 80% of the most hub disruption any window passing the clauses holds (disruption = 523 per B6 hub movement cancelled with code B or C + its weather and NAS delay minutes); then most disrupted, busiest, earliest

clauses.tails_known: every B6 hub movement in the window has a tail, and every tail is typed
clauses.weather_causes: (B+C)/(A+B+C) of the airline's cancellations in scope >= 0.8, vacuous with none

disruption.candidates: the 60 (day, hub) of most disruption in their disruption window, at least 1046

rules.days: a day whose previous and next days are in the loaded months; controls the first hub passing of 2023-06-10 (JFK); 2024-01-04 (JFK, BOS); 2024-01-24 (JFK, BOS); eval the candidates of most leverage passing every clause of scripts/references.py screen (naive >= 10% above the anchor, the follower <= 15% above hindsight, hindsight proven), at most one per (date, hub): 2023-07-09 BOS, 2023-07-14 JFK, 2023-07-16 BOS, 2023-07-16 JFK, 2024-01-07 BOS, 2024-02-13 JFK, 2024-08-02 JFK, 2024-08-03 JFK, 2024-08-04 BOS, 2024-08-04 JFK, 2024-08-06 BOS, 2024-08-19 BOS, 2024-08-19 JFK, 2025-01-19 BOS, 2025-01-19 JFK, 2025-02-16 BOS, 2025-07-02 JFK, 2025-07-09 JFK, 2025-07-13 JFK, 2025-07-14 JFK; train every other candidate on a date with no eval or control task
rules.news: advisories signed from start - 720 min, routine METARs from start - 180 min, the TAF and forecast discussion in force at start; all up to the latest flight's sched_dep + dmax
rules.caps: per constrained airport (BOS, EWR, JFK, LGA) the scope uses and local hour from start to 23: max(scope's realized movements, round(B6's share of all carriers' scheduled movements x all carriers' realized movements) - B6's realized movements outside the scope)
rules.nominal: the scope's scheduled movements, the same airports and hours
rules.lb: departed: max(0, DepDelay - LateAircraftDelay); cancelled: the 75th percentile of that among B6 departures from the origin within 90 min (else the whole day)
rules.dmax: max(360, start - sched_dep + 60): a flight still unflown an hour into the task can leave
